name: Customized Napkin Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted from high-quality 5mm thick wood, providing both durability and a natural, elegant look. The wooden panels are precisely cut for a clean and smooth finish.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions:
    - The side panels measure 6.5 x 5.5 inches ~ 16.51 x 13.97 cm. 
    - The base of the napkin holder measures approximately 6.5 x 5.5 inches ~  16.51 x 13.97 cm.
    - Slot positions and quantities can be adjusted to match your personalized design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Produced with advanced UV printing technology for vivid, sharp, and long-lasting images printed on both sides of the product. The high-resolution printing ensures beautiful and detailed personalization.

 

  • Functionality Use:
    This napkin holder is a stylish and practical accessory to keep napkins organized and easily accessible on your dining table, kitchen counter, or office. Its customized name or design adds a personal, decorative touch to any space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:
    A thoughtful, unique gift idea for everyone on any occasion — housewarmings, birthdays, weddings, holidays, or corporate gifts. Its blend of function and personalization makes it a memorable and practical present.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Customized Napkin Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
